definitions.name: indexSide
definitions.definition:
def indexSide (r : Fin 3) (i : Fin 4) : Bool :=
  (coordinateQuartet Fin.val).side r.val i.val

reindexResolution
resolutionFin
definitions.definition:
def resolutionFin (r : Resolution) : Fin 3 :=
  ⟨resolutionIndex r,by cases r <;> decide⟩

definitions.name: presentIndices
definitions.definition: def presentIndices (g : Fin 3 → Bool) : List (Fin 3) := ([0,1,2] : List (Fin 3)).filter g

definitions.name: indexedMean
definitions.definition:
def indexedMean (g : Fin 3 → Bool) : ℚ :=
  ((presentIndices g).filter (fun r => r!=0)).length / ((presentIndices g).length : ℚ)

definitions.name: indexedPairMean
finiteWitnessMask
definitions.definition:
def finiteWitnessMask (T : Tree) (tips : List Nat) (v : Fin 4 → Nat) (r : Fin 3) : Bool :=
  (T.internalIntervals 1).any (fun e => edgeWitness tips e.1 e.2 (coordinateQuartet v) r.val)
